Who We Are

Our Quality Is Unmatched

We have been part of the auction community for a long time, working with clients across Georgia to provide the best care and service for every need. Our team is among the most knowledgeable in the field across many categories of antiques and collectibles, and we are able to acquire items for our clients at prices well below our competitors.

We began by running an antique mall, Big Shanty Antiques, and have since grown our services with the same friendliness and professionalism extended to every new and returning customer — whenever people seek our kind of expertise.
